name: toc
title: Table of contents
description: The headings of a page as links, with the section in view marked by CSS.
use: The headings of a long page as a column of links beside it. Where the browser has scroll-target-group the link of the section in view is marked without script; elsewhere a script or the server sets aria-current.

instead.when: The links go to other pages
The entries nest many levels deep and fold

platform.fallback: No link is marked until a script or the server sets aria-current on it
Each current link draws its own mark on the rail, which does not glide

classes.name: toc
classes.description: The container, on a nav with a label such as "On this page"; a scroll-target group

classes.name: toc-list
classes.description: A list of links on a hairline rail. A toc-list inside a list item is a deeper level: it shares the rail and indents its links by one step

classes.name: toc-link
classes.description: A link to a heading by its id; the one of the section in view is in ink, with a mark on the rail

states.name: in view
states.description: Matched by the browser for the link whose target is in view

states.name: current
states.description: Set by the server or a script; drawn the same

properties.name: --toc-indent
properties.description: The distance from the rail to the words, and one level's indent

example:
On this page

  • Theme
  • Corners
